chain_functions.name: fn_create_profile_on_signup
chain_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_create_profile_on_signup()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (
    id,
    email,
    full_name,
    course_level,
    institution,
    role,
    account_type,
    timezone,
    created_at
  )
  VALUES (
    NEW.id,
    lower(btrim(NEW.email)),
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', ''),
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'course_level',
    'In-house',
    'student',
    'self_registered',
    'Asia/Kolkata',
    NOW()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

chain_functions.name: fn_sync_profile_email_from_auth

chain_functions.args: p_name text, p_whatsapp_number text, p_course text, p_email text, p_content_id uuid, p_content_type text, p_content_name text, p_requester_user_id uuid
chain_functions.name: submit_access_request
chain_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_access_request(p_name text, p_whatsapp_number text, p_course text, p_email text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_content_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_content_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_content_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_requester_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$BEGIN
  IF p_name IS NULL OR trim(p_name) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Name is required';
  END IF;
  IF p_whatsapp_number IS NULL OR trim(p_whatsapp_number) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'WhatsApp number is required';
  END IF;
  IF p_course IS NULL OR trim(p_course) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Course is required';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO access_requests (
    name, whatsapp_number, course, email,
    content_id, content_type, content_name, requester_user_id
  ) VALUES (
    trim(p_name), trim(p_whatsapp_number), p_course,
    CASE WHEN p_email IS NOT NULL AND trim(p_email) <> '' THEN trim(p_email) ELSE NULL END,
    p_content_id, p_content_type, p_content_name, p_requester_user_id
  );

  INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, title, message, metadata)
  SELECT
    p.id,
    'access_request',
    'New access request from ' || trim(p_name),
    p_course || CASE WHEN p_content_name IS NOT NULL THEN ' — saw: ' || p_content_name ELSE '' END,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'name', trim(p_name),
      'whatsapp', trim(p_whatsapp_number),
      'course', p_course,
      'content_name', p_content_name
    )
  FROM profiles p
  WHERE p.role IN ('admin', 'super_admin');
END;$function$

auth_users_triggers.name: trg_create_profile_on_signup
auth_users_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_create_profile_on_signup AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_create_profile_on_signup()

auth_users_triggers.name: trg_sync_profile_email_from_auth
auth_users_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_sync_profile_email_from_auth AFTER UPDATE OF email ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.email)::text IS DISTINCT FROM (new.email)::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_sync_profile_email_from_auth()
